fields.quoted_span:
It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates

                  or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
fields.note: Both prohibitions (sale/license/provision and landlord use), the definition, separate-violation rule and tenant remedies match §§ 98.1102-98.1104.

fields.quoted_span:
A tenant may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to

                        $1,000 per violation of this Division, in a civil action against a landlord.
fields.note: The $1,000 cap, monthly and per-property separate violations, fee-shifting and the 30th-day effective date are all in the document. The penalty is sought by tenants in a civil action, not imposed by the city.

fields.quoted_span:
This Ordinance will take effect and be in force on the thirtieth day from

        and after its final passage.
fields.note: The rule's effective_date is null and its formula (30 days after enactment, with a null anchor date) matches the text. The passage date is blank in the document, so no calendar date can be computed.

fields.quoted_span:
I certify that the Council of the City of San Diego adopted this Ordinance at a meeting held on

______________________________.
fields.note: The document is a staff report and draft ordinance with blank number, passage and adoption dates. This supports a proposed or pending status, but adoption as of the query date cannot be confirmed.

fields.quoted_span:
Residential rental property has the same meaning as in San Diego Municipal

           Code section 98.0702, as may be amended.
fields.note: The ordinance sets no unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy or landlord-size limits, and the Division 7 exemptions are not incorporated. The detail that § 98.0702 covers dwellings in mobilehome parks is not in this document, which only incorporates the definition by reference.

fields.quoted_span: §98.1103   Use and Sale of Algorithmic Devices Prohibited
fields.note: The citation and aliases match the text: Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 11, §§ 98.1101-98.1104, O-2025-107 and the ordinance title.
